headline: Indian IT services showed uneven growth in Q2 FY27, with AI‑driven revenue gains offset by modest top‑line expansion at larger players.
summary: Revenue growth ranged from sub‑2% at Infosys to over 50% at Coforge. Profit margins improved at HCLTech and TCS, while Infosys and Wipro saw profit pressure. AI revenue contributed materially, especially at HCLTech and TCS. Guidance was trimmed at Infosys but raised at Coforge and Mphasis.

themes.title: AI‑led revenue boost
themes.detail: Several firms cited AI as a key driver of deal wins and profit growth.

themes.title: Margin expansion
themes.detail: Coforge raised EBIT margin guidance; TCS and HCLTech posted strong operating margins.

themes.title: Profit pressure at large caps
themes.detail: Infosys profit grew only 6% YoY and Wipro profit fell 1.9% YoY.

themes.title: Headcount dynamics
themes.detail: HCLTech added 6.5k staff but attrition remained high; Wipro reduced headcount.
